action: A helicopter with a turning rotor drifts across the frame, then gets smaller as if it is flying away from the viewer.
identity_gap: The cartoon tilts the whole body nose-down with a sloped skid, while the doodle sits level with a flat horizontal skid. The cartoon line is also thinner than the doodle's heavy marker stroke.
notes: Frames 1-4 read as one continuous close-up drift. Frame 5 cuts to a full-body view at a different scale and position, and frame 7 roughly halves the size again, so the recession reads as jumps rather than a smooth fly-away. The construction carries over clearly: hooked tail tip, cockpit window line, asymmetric rotor cross, two splayed struts and a single skid.
